prompt: **Linear Regression Edge Case:** What happens to the OLS closed-form solution $\hat{\beta} = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T y$ if you duplicate one feature column (so $X_2 = X_1$) or if $p > n$ (more features than samples)? Why does Ridge Regression $\hat{\beta} = (X^T X + \lambda I)^{-1} X^T y$ guarantee invertibility for any $\lambda > 0$?
